summary: The coup needs a public story. Under that, Rod begins the old tale of the Reiss family, and Eren hears that his father stood in that chapel.

segments.ja: エルヴィンのクーデターは、銃だけではありません。新聞と、貴族の分裂と、ザックレーの判断が要ります。要る材料の一つが、レイスが本当の王家だという昔話です。昔話を、街はまだフリッツ王の配給で覆われています。覆われた街で、リーブス商会は中央と調査のあいだを歩き続けます。歩き続ける父を、フレーゲルは怖がっています。怖がる息子に、父はまだ本当の側を言い切りません。
segments.en: Erwin's coup is not only guns. It needs newspapers, a split among nobles, and Zachary's judgment. One of the needed materials is the old story that Reiss is the true royal house. The city is still covered by King Fritz's distribution. In the covered city, the Reeves company keeps walking between the interior and the survey. Flegel is afraid of the father who keeps walking. The father does not yet say clearly, to the son who is afraid, which side is real.

segments.en: Kenny erases Reeves, who knew too much. The method of erasing is to make it look like the Survey Corps' work. The corpse that was shown turns the city's rumor toward the survey once. Flegel receives the rumor that was turned as his father's death. The son who received it is pressed to hide, or to make the name public. Hange is in the place that presses. Hange, who is there, does not use fear as material. She sends him into the middle of the city as a witness. Sending him is the first step of putting the old story on paper.

segments.en: Before inheriting the company's remains, Flegel tells the order in which his father was killed. The people he tells are the people of the street. At first they suspect the Survey Corps. Into the ears that suspect, he sets the story of the interior's guns. The story he sets becomes the continuation of the smoke signal. If the newspapers pick up the continuation, the coup becomes a public question. The question is: who is the king. Rod, still inside a cave, is trying to overwrite the who with a different tale.

segments.ja: ヒストリアは、父ロッドと向き合う場所へ運ばれます。運ばれた場所は、礼拝堂の下です。下で、ロッドは娘に昔話を始めます。始める話は、壁の力はレイスの血が継いできた、ということです。継いできた力を、彼は呪いではなく使命として語ります。語る声は優しいです。優しい声が、エレンを同じ洞窟の鎖に置いています。置かれたエレンは、父グリシャの名をまだこの話の犯人としては聞いていません。
segments.en: Historia is carried to a place where she faces her father, Rod. The place she was carried is under a chapel. Under it, Rod begins an old story for his daughter. The story he begins is that the power of the walls has been inherited by Reiss blood. He tells the power that has been inherited as a mission, not a curse. The voice that tells it is gentle. The gentle voice has set Eren in chains in the same cave. Eren, who was set there, has not yet heard his father Grisha's name as the culprit of this story.

segments.ja: ロッドの昔話は、ヒストリアを器と呼びます。呼ぶ器は、兄姉が持てなかった力を受け取る体です。受け取るには、今その力を持つ者を食べる必要があります。必要の先に、エレンがいます。いる理由を、ロッドは王家の復旧だと言います。言う復旧は、壁の中の人を真の平和へ戻す、です。戻す平和の代金が、エレンの死です。死を、ヒストリアはまだ承諾していません。
segments.en: Rod's old story calls Historia a vessel. The vessel he calls is a body that receives the power her siblings could not hold. To receive it, she needs to eat the person who holds that power now. Ahead of the need is Eren. Rod says the reason he is there is the restoration of the royal house. The restoration he states is to return the people inside the walls to a true peace. The price of the peace he would return is Eren's death. Historia has not yet accepted the death.

segments.ja: エレンの記憶の端に、父が家族を殺した夜が混ざります。混ざる像は、まだ完全な昔話ではありません。ありませんが、レイスの祠と父の姿が重なり始めます。重なり始めた罪を、彼は自分の中の巨人の出所として感じます。感じる出所は、自分で得た力ではない、ということです。ではない力が、ヒストリアに食われる対象になっています。なっている事実を、彼は鎖の中で否定しきれません。
segments.en: At the edge of Eren's memory, the night his father killed a family mixes in. The image that mixes is not yet a complete old story. Even so, the Reiss chapel and his father's figure start to overlap. He feels the sin that has started to overlap as the source of the Titan inside him. The source he feels means the power was not one he obtained himself. The power that is not that has become the thing Historia would eat. He cannot fully deny, inside the chains, the fact that it has become so.

segments.en: Kenny holds a gun outside the cave's ritual. The reason he holds it is not loyalty to Rod alone. Even so, today is still his turn to watch where the power sits. During the turn, he is waiting for Levi to trace the way here. The face that waits remains a killing face. With that face, he does not look at the royal ritual as a religion. The eyes that do not look will later need the story of the Ackermans. The need is outside this old story.

segments.ja: 洞窟の外では、フレーゲルの証言が紙になります。なる紙を、中央は奪おうとします。奪おうとする手を、調査兵団と住民が押さえます。押さえた結果、王の名への疑いが通りに出ます。出た疑いが、エルヴィンの凍結を内側から割ります。割る力は、軍隊の反乱であると同時に、物語の公開です。公開された物語は、まだロッドの完全版ではありません。ではありませんが、フリッツの旗は揺れ始めます。
segments.en: Outside the cave, Flegel's testimony becomes paper. The interior tries to seize the paper it becomes. The Survey Corps and the residents pin the hand that tries to seize it. As a result of the pinning, suspicion of the king's name comes out into the street. The suspicion that came out cracks Erwin's freeze from the inside. The power that cracks it is a military revolt and, at the same time, the publication of a story. The published story is not yet Rod's complete version. Even so, Fritz's flag starts to shake.

segments.en: Hitch and Marlo, who were on the military police side, also touch this suspicion. Marlo, having touched it, thinks that if the rules are real he cannot allow the interior's concealment. Hitch, thinking, still holds Annie's absence as a personal hole. Still holding it, the two of them start to move to the side that hands out the survey's paper. segments.titleEn: A father speaking to a daughter
segments.ja: ロッドは、ヒストリアの不幸な子供時代を、自分の不在のせいにはしません。しませんが、今日は父として肩に触れます。触れる手が、器を用意する手でもあります。ある二つの手を、彼女は見分け始めます。見分けは、クリスタとして頷くことでは終わりません。終わらない見分けが、昔話の聞き方を変えます。変えた聞き方は、使命の言葉を一度疑うことです。疑いは、まだ拒否の行動にはなっていません。
segments.en: Rod does not make Historia's unhappy childhood the fault of his own absence. Even so, today he touches her shoulder as a father. The hand that touches is also a hand preparing a vessel. She starts to tell the two hands apart. Telling them apart does not end with nodding as Christa. The telling-apart that does not end changes how she listens to the old story. The changed way of listening is to doubt the words of mission once. The doubt has not yet become an act of refusal.

segments.en: Eren is told that his death is the price of peace. The place he is told is not a ground for fighting. In the place that is not, he does not search for words of agreement. Rod's old story fills in the insufficient memory on its own. The story that fills it in makes Grisha a thief.

segments.ja: 昔話の一節は、グリシャ・イェーガーがレイスの力を奪った、です。奪った夜に、ヒストリアの兄姉が死に、フリーダの名が残ります。残る名を、エレンは自分の中の誰かとして感じ始めます。感じ始めた恐怖は、自分が父の続きである、ということです。続きであるなら、壁の中の不幸の原因はイェーガーです。である原因を、彼はヒストリアに償う義務のように受け取ります。受け取る義務は、ロッドの望む器と一致して見えます。
segments.en: One passage of the old story is that Grisha Yeager stole the Reiss power. On the night he stole it, Historia's siblings died, and Frieda's name remains. Eren starts to feel the name that remains as someone inside himself. The fear he has started to feel is that he is the continuation of his father. If he is the continuation, the cause of the unhappiness inside the walls is Yeager. He receives the cause that is so like a duty to repay Historia. The duty he receives looks as if it matches the vessel Rod wants.

segments.en: The old story on the city's paper and the old story in the cave's mouth have not yet become one. While they have not, Erwin exposes a false king, and Rod advances the moving of the true power. The two who advance do not see each other. Not seeing is today's danger. At the center of the danger, Historia's choice is still on hold. She postpones the hold with her father's gentle voice. The postponement ends between the next trust and the next reply.

vocab.exampleEn: Rod's old story calls Historia a vessel. The vessel he calls is a body that receives the power her siblings could not hold. To receive it, she needs to eat the person who holds that power now. Ahead of the need is Eren. Rod says the reason he is there is the restoration of the royal house. The restoration he states is to return the people inside the walls to a true peace. The price of the peace he would return is Eren's death. Historia has not yet accepted the death.

vocab.exampleJa: エレンの記憶の端に、父が家族を殺した夜が混ざります。
vocab.exampleEn: At the edge of Eren's memory, the night his father killed a family mixes in. The image that mixes is not yet a complete old story. Even so, the Reiss chapel and his father's figure start to overlap. He feels the sin that has started to overlap as the source of the Titan inside him. The source he feels means the power was not one he obtained himself. The power that is not that has become the thing Historia would eat. He cannot fully deny, inside the chains, the fact that it has become so.

vocab.exampleJa: 新聞と、貴族の分裂と、ザックレーの判断が要ります。
vocab.exampleEn: Erwin's coup is not only guns. It needs newspapers, a split among nobles, and Zachary's judgment. One of the needed materials is the old story that Reiss is the true royal house. The city is still covered by King Fritz's distribution. In the covered city, the Reeves company keeps walking between the interior and the survey. Flegel is afraid of the father who keeps walking. The father does not yet say clearly, to the son who is afraid, which side is real.

vocab.exampleJa: 昔話は、ロッドが娘に語る王家の歴史です。
vocab.exampleEn: Today's words. The old story is the royal history Rod tells his daughter. Reiss is the blood of that history. Reeves is the merchant who was erased for knowing too much. Flegel is the son who put his father's death on paper. Grisha drops a shadow inside Eren as the father who stole the power. Historia is being called a vessel. Eren is in chains as the thing that vessel would eat.

vocab.exampleJa: フレーゲルは、商会の跡を継ぐより先に、父が殺された順序を話します。
vocab.exampleEn: Before inheriting the company's remains, Flegel tells the order in which his father was killed. The people he tells are the people of the street. At first they suspect the Survey Corps. Into the ears that suspect, he sets the story of the interior's guns. The story he sets becomes the continuation of the smoke signal. If the newspapers pick up the continuation, the coup becomes a public question. The question is: who is the king. Rod, still inside a cave, is trying to overwrite the who with a different tale.
